goals.label: GATE Chemical Preparation
goals.description: Formulas in CRE, Mass Transfer, Heat Transfer, and Process Calculations

goals.label: Oil & Gas / Petrochemicals (IOCL, ONGC, Reliance)
goals.description: Refinery processes, distillation columns, catalytic cracking, and safety HAZOP

goals.label: Pharma & Specialty Chemical Manufacturing
goals.description: Batch reactor scale-up, crystallization, bioprocesses, and GMP regulations

goals.label: Process Simulation & Aspen Engineering
goals.description: Aspen Plus, HYSYS flowsheeting, heat exchanger networks (Pinch Analysis), and P&ID

resources.title: Chemical Reaction Engineering Reactor Design Equations Cheatsheet
resources.description: Original study guide covering design equations for Batch, CSTR, and PFR reactors, Space Time, Thiele Modulus, and reactor sizing comparisons.
resources.bestFor: CRE exams, reactor design problems and GATE Chemical

resources.title: Mass Transfer Distillation & McCabe-Thiele Method Quick Guide
resources.description: Original step-by-step solver guide for McCabe-Thiele graphical construction, minimum reflux ratio, q-line equations, and Fenske equation.
resources.bestFor: Distillation column calculations and semester midterms

resources.title: Process Dynamics & Control Transfer Functions & Tuning Reference
resources.description: Original handbook on First-Order Plus Dead Time (FOPDT) systems, Ziegler-Nichols PID tuning, Root Locus for chemical processes, and Routh stability.
resources.bestFor: Process control exams and plant automation vivas

resources.title: NPTEL Chemical Reaction Engineering - I by IIT Guwahati
resources.description: Prof. Bishnupada Mandal video course on kinetics of homogeneous reactions, interpretation of batch reactor data, single ideal reactors, and reactor combinations.
resources.bestFor: Reactor kinetics and reactor combination design

resources.title: NPTEL Mass Transfer Operations - I by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. B. C. Meikap complete video series on Fick's Law of diffusion, mass transfer coefficients, absorption in packed towers, and distillation.
resources.bestFor: Core Mass Transfer theory, diffusion, and absorption

resources.title: NPTEL Heat Transfer Operations by IIT Madras
resources.description: Prof. S. Pushpavanam covering conduction, convective heat transfer in pipes, boiling and condensation, shell and tube heat exchanger design, and radiation.
resources.bestFor: Heat exchanger sizing and chemical process heating

resources.title: NPTEL Process Dynamics and Control by IIT Bombay
resources.description: Prof. Sachin C. Patwardhan covering dynamic modeling of chemical systems, transfer functions, stability, frequency response, and feedback control loops.
resources.bestFor: Chemical process control and dynamic system stability

resources.title: MIT 10.34 Numerical Methods Applied to Chemical Engineering
resources.description: MIT OCW course on numerical solutions of ODEs/PDEs, nonlinear algebraic equation solving, and parameter estimation in chemical processes.
resources.bestFor: Numerical modeling of reaction kinetics and transport

resources.title: MIT 10.10 Introduction to Chemical Engineering
resources.description: MIT course on material and energy balances, conservation laws, transient balances, and chemical manufacturing flowsheet calculations.

resources.title: NPTEL Transport Phenomena by IIT Madras
resources.description: Prof. Sunando Dasgupta covering unified momentum, heat, and mass transport balances, shell balances, velocity/temperature/concentration profiles.

resources.title: NPTEL Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics by IIT Roorkee
resources.description: Lectures on PVT behavior of pure fluids, equations of state (Van der Waals, Redlich-Kwong), residual properties, and vapor-liquid equilibria (VLE).
resources.bestFor: Phase equilibria and thermodynamic property estimation

resources.title: Chemical Engineering Guy Process Engineering YouTube Lectures
resources.description: Visual explanations of chemical engineering unit operations, fluid flow pumps, distillation columns, valves, and heat exchangers.
resources.bestFor: Practical industrial equipment animations and operation

resources.title: NPTEL Mechanical Operations by IIT Kharagpur
resources.description: Prof. B. C. Meikap covering particle size analysis, screening, comminution laws (Rittinger, Kick, Bond), sedimentation, and filtration.

resources.title: NPTEL Plant Design and Economics by IIT Roorkee
resources.description: Lectures on chemical plant capital cost estimation, profitability evaluation, discounted cash flow, optimum design, and safety regulations.
resources.bestFor: Cap-stone plant design and economic feasibility

resources.title: LearnChemE University of Colorado Interactive Simulations
resources.description: Interactive chemical engineering simulations, screencasts, and conceptual problems for thermodynamics, kinetics, and fluid mechanics.
resources.bestFor: Interactive visual simulations and concept tests
